s.note: Potato and cheese pierogies with fried onions. Richie quits the grill for LA stand-up.
s.how: Mix the flour, egg, sour cream and half the butter, melted, into a soft dough and rest it. Mash the potato with the cheddar and season well. Roll the dough thin, cut 8cm rounds, fill, fold and pinch the edges shut. Boil the pierogies until they float, then fry in the rest of the butter with the onions until golden. Serve with sour cream and chives.
shop: 125g sour cream, plus extra to serve@Dairy

s.note: Hot buffalo wings with blue cheese dip.
s.how: Toss the wings with the baking powder and salt and bake on a rack at 220C, turning once, until crisp. Melt the butter into the hot sauce. Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream and mayo. Toss the wings in the sauce and serve with the dip and celery.

m.note: Grilled lobster tails, garlic butter and shoestring fries.
m.how: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Mash the butter with the garlic, parsley and lemon zest. Split the tails down the back, spread with half the butter and grill shell side down until the flesh turns white. Melt the rest of the butter for dipping and serve with lemon wedges and the fries.

m.note: Steak, provolone, vinegar slaw and fries, all in the bread.
m.how: Bake the fries at 220C until golden. Toss the cabbage with the vinegar, oil, sugar and salt. Sear the steaks in a very hot pan for a minute a side and lay the provolone on top to melt. Pile steak, chips, slaw and tomato between the bread and press down.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge and toasted almonds. Jeanie falls twice on the ice.
w.how: Heat the cream and golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir until glossy. Scoop the ice cream into 4 chilled glasses. Pour over the hot fudge and finish with almonds and a cherry.

d.note: Alex's water dance on the chair. Gin, cucumber and elderflower, topped with soda.
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and cucumber ribbons. Add the gin, cordial and a squeeze of lime, then top with soda.

shopping: 125g sour cream, plus extra to serve@Dairy
